C0363.title: Credential Brute-Force Attack on a Beijing Education Company's Academic Scheduling System Leads to Data Breach
C0363.summary: On August 1, 2023, a post on an overseas forum titled 'Over 700,000 Order Records Exposed from an Education Site' indicated a suspected data breach at a Beijing-based education company.
